mapper.update: UPDATE pk_match SET status = #{status}, winner_user_id = #{winnerUserId}, questions_completed = #{questionsCompleted}, player_a_score = #{playerAScore}, player_b_score = #{playerBScore}, player_a_points_delta = #{playerAPointsDelta}, player_b_points_delta = #{playerBPointsDelta}, finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'playing'
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS matchId, m.player_a_id AS playerAId, ua.username AS playerAUsername, m.player_b_id AS playerBId, ub.username AS playerBUsername, m.winner_user_id AS winnerUserId, m.status AS status, m.questions_completed AS questionsCompleted, m.player_a_score AS playerAScore, m.player_b_score AS playerBScore, m.player_a_points_delta AS playerAPointsDelta, m.player_b_points_delta AS playerBPointsDelta, m.started_at AS startedAt, m.finished_at AS finishedAt FROM pk_match m LEFT JOIN user ua ON ua.id = m.player_a_id LEFT JOIN user ub ON ub.id = m.player_b_id WHERE (m.player_a_id = #{userId} OR m.player_b_id = #{userId}) AND m.status IN ('finished', 'forfeit') ORDER BY m.finished_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT winner_user_id FROM pk_match WHERE id != #{excludeMatchId} AND winner_user_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('finished', 'forfeit') AND ( (player_a_id = #{userAId} AND player_b_id = #{userBId}) OR (player_a_id = #{userBId} AND player_b_id = #{userAId}) ) ORDER BY finished_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
